description: RC3 P8 weak-feeder voltage-dip case: a 1.0 pu slack source feeds the motor bus through one feeder of 0.3 + j1.2 pu on 100 MVA, with no other load and no charging, so the motor-bus voltage at any slip is the closed-form divider |Zm / (Zf + Zm)|. Motor M1 has a fan load; motor M2 (same machine) a constant 0.4 pu load torque above its locked-rotor torque at the dipped voltage, so it stalls at standstill. Hand-written, not a real network.
